indicator_definition: Ratio of total equivalised disposable income of the richest 20% to that of the poorest 20% of the population. Measures income inequality. Higher values indicate greater inequality. Data from EU-SILC.
rationale: Income inequality limits social mobility and cohesion. Progress means a declining S80/S20 ratio reflecting a narrowing gap between richest and poorest.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through EU-SILC using equivalised disposable income. Divides total income of top quintile by that of bottom quintile. Published annually by Eurostat.
